title: A short introduction
text:
About
A short introduction
I am Hongda Zhao. This is my personal notebook for research questions, technical work, academic life, and observations beyond the screen.



About me



I work in bioinformatics and computational genomics, with a particular interest in viruses, genomes, and computational methods for biological discovery.
I use this site to keep useful ideas in one place: notes from research, tools I want to remember, academic experiences, and small observations from everyday life.





Away from the screen

Field observations
I enjoy observing birds and biodiversity. Some of those photographs and field notes may appear here over time.

title: Mirusvirus paper accepted for publication in Current Biology
text:
Publication record2024.04.30
Mirusvirus paper accepted for publication in Current Biology
My first-author study used eukaryotic genomic data to examine the host range and diversity of mirusviruses.





MANUSCRIPT / RESEARCH IMAGE
Image to be added — manuscript, research graphic, or personal photograph.




Record

The manuscript was accepted on 30 April 2024 and published online on 27 May 2024.
Zhao H., Meng L., Hikida H., Ogata H. “Eukaryotic genomic data uncover an extensive host range of mirusviruses.” Current Biology 34(12), 2633–2643.e3 (2024). DOI: 10.1016/j.cub.2024.04.085.
The study examines mirusvirus signals in eukaryotic genomic data and shows that these viruses likely infect a broad range of eukaryotes across diverse environments.
